title: Stranger Things season 4 — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
What looks like free choice in Stranger Things season 4 is older than choice itself. The fourth season of the American science fiction horror drama television series Stranger Things, marketed as Stranger Things 4, was released worldwide on the streaming service Netflix in two volumes. The first set of seven episodes was released on May 27, 2022, and the second set of two episodes was released on July 1.

The selfish-gene reading of Stranger Things season 4 makes it less romantic and far more precise. Martin Brenner's return to the show would be a surprise, but his presence in the season leaked on his first day of filming when paparazzi snapped a photo of Modine in a convertible. On March 15, 2021, set photos were leaked of a trailer park in Griffin, Georgia that was dressed with tendrils from the Upside Down.
